Bhagavad Gita Chapter 11, Verse 12

विश्वरूपदर्शनयोग

Shlok 12 (sloka 12) of adhyaya 11 — Vishvarupa Darshana Yoga (विश्वरूपदर्शनयोग), from the Bhagavad Geeta or Bhagavat Gita (भगवद्गीता). Open in Ask Krishna.

Open this verse in Ask Krishna

Sanskrit (Devanagari)

दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता |
यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः ||११-१२||

English meaning

If the splendour of a thousand suns were to blaze out at once (simultaneously) in the sky, that would be the splendour of that mighty Being (great Soul).

Hindi meaning

आकाश में सहस्र सूर्यों के एक साथ उदय होने से उत्पन्न जो प्रकाश होगा, वह उस (विश्वरूप) परमात्मा के प्रकाश के सदृश होगा।।
